label: Cell plans and origin
text: BI.O.A2.1 Cell plans and origin. Cell theory: organisms are cells or assemblages of cells, and cells arise from cells. It is a historical generalisation with one stated exception class: the origin of life. Prokaryotic plans (bacteria, archaea) lack a nucleus. Eukaryotic plans have a nucleus and membrane-bounded organelles. Endosymbiosis explains mitochondria and plastids. Origin of life is an OPEN programme; it uses CH.O.A3 and EA.O.A3.

warrant.standard: Perturbation with controls; imaging with stated resolution; replication across cell lines
warrant.defeaters: Fixation artefact; overexpression artefact; cell-line misidentification
